## Why this change?

Describe the problem and the smallest complete solution.

- [ ] Master skill / playbook

## Verification

List exact commands, exit codes and any actual Studio/MCP/device evidence. Do not claim live tests from offline checks.

## Safety and licenses

- [ ] No credentials, private player data, unpublished place IDs or unlicensed third-party content included

- [ ] License/attribution updated if needed
